answer_1.quote: In this paper, our work focuses on KGC, specifically addressing two tasks: (i) triple classification, assessing the correctness of a given triple (h, r, t), and (ii) link prediction, identifying the most plausible tail entity t for a given query (h, r, ?).
answer_1.outputs: Structured responses (True/False for triple classification; entity names for link prediction)

answer_2.quote: Following previous work, we evaluate triple classification using four standard metrics: accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score, and assess link prediction with two metrics: Hits@1 and MRR.
